description: Source code for the BotService in the Mattermost plugin API, providing methods to manage bots including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and ensuring bot existence with profile image handling.

classes.name: BotService
classes.description: Service class providing bot management functionalities in Mattermost plugin API.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieve a bot by its user ID, optionally including deleted bots.

methods.name: List
methods.description: List bots with pagination and filtering options.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Create a new bot and its associated user.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Apply a patch to update bot details.

methods.name: UpdateActive
methods.description: Set a bot as active or inactive.

methods.name: DeletePermanently
methods.description: Permanently delete a bot and its user.

methods.name: EnsureBot
methods.description: Ensure a bot exists, creating it if necessary, with optional profile image.

methods.name: ensureBot
methods.description: Internal method to handle bot creation and profile image setting.

methods.name: ensureBotUser
methods.description: Create or retrieve the bot user, with mutex locking to prevent race conditions.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Read a profile image file from the bundle path.
